text:
Type: hand-knotted Persian area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, study, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, bohemian
Materials: hand-knotted wool-look short pile, fine dense knotting
Colors: deep brick red, dark navy, rust orange, ivory accents
Shape: rectangle with a central diamond medallion, small tribal motifs, wide geometric border, flat low pile, medium size, richly patterned
Feel: warm, rich, timeless, crafted
Goes with: dark or warm wood, leather, brass, cream walls; traditional, classic or bohemian living rooms and studies

product.name: PERSISK HAMADAN
product.description: Hand-knotted by skilled craftspeople, and therefore unique in design and size.
